learnings: Tool errors (HTTP failures, parse errors) should not force an inconclusive verdict when other models successfully complete the audit and find no issues
When multiple models agree on PKGBUILD safety but some fail on peripheral config files (.nvchecker.toml, .SRCINFO), the successful PKGBUILD analysis should carry decisive weight
Implement retry logic or fallback models for transient API errors to prevent incomplete audits from blocking verdicts
Distinguish between 'file could not be audited due to tool error' and 'file audited and found safe' in the final verdict calculation
